# HighLevelKit

> An independent GoHighLevel tools directory with 41 app listings and a practical hiring guide.

Listings are directory descriptions, not hands-on verification. Confirm pricing, compatibility and current availability with the provider. No unverified review counts or ratings are supplied.

## Search and data
- [Agent documentation](https://highlevelkit.com/for-agents): Query parameters and response semantics.
- [Search API](https://highlevelkit.com/api/search?q=automation): Public GET endpoint; no key required. Supports q, category, limit and offset.
- [OpenAPI specification](https://highlevelkit.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable search API contract.
- [Catalog JSON](https://highlevelkit.com/catalog.json): Complete records, canonical URLs and provider links.
- [Full text catalog](https://highlevelkit.com/llms-full.txt): All records in one plain-text response.
- [Sitemap](https://highlevelkit.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical HTML pages.

## Key pages
- [Browse tools](https://highlevelkit.com/apps)
- [Guides](https://highlevelkit.com/guides)
- [GHL jobs and hiring guide](https://highlevelkit.com/guides/ghl-hire): GHL Hire is on a rebuild waitlist as checked November 16, 2026; this guide does not list live jobs.
